messages:
cheng: Heads up — after the q8 bring-up on staging I’m seeing a weird failure mode in our multilingual evals. BLEU/chrF drop for ja/zh pairs when input contains emoji + ZWJ sequences. eval-bot posted diffs below.

eval-bot: automated-eval: run 2026-03-18T09:12Z -> baseline vs q8-staging: ja->zh BLEU -0.62, chrF -1.3; failing sample count 48/500. report: https://internal/reports/2026-03-18/grapheme-fusion

alice: repro steps I used: `git checkout q8-quant-rollout`, run `python eval/runner.py --pairs ja-zh --subset emoji-zwj`

alice: tokenizer output for one failing case (original: "今日は👩‍💻仕事が大変です"):
```
# tokens (expected): [ '今日', 'は', '👩', '‍', '💻', '仕事', 'が', '大変', 'です' ]
# q8 tokenizer: [ '今日', 'は', '👩‍💻', '仕事', 'が', '大変', 'です' ]
# note: emoji+ZWJ collapsed into single token '👩‍💻' which shifts alignment
```

cheng: yup exactly — upstream token alignment shifts cause decoder to drop or hallucinate short phrases. This only shows up in mixed-script sentences with emoji ZWJ or surrogate pairs.

maria: any recent changes to normalization or ICU libs in the quant build?

hiro: I saw a tiny change in tokenization layer in PR #4123: we switched normalize_unicode to NFKC in the q8 runner to stabilize widths. Might be related.

alice: bisect looks like PR #4123 landed right before the quant build. quick check suggests NFC vs NFKC changes how ZWJ/emoji are composed.

eval-bot: bisect snapshot: probable culprit PR 4123 (tokenizer:norm NFKC) — confidence 0.89.

cheng: if true, this is an edge case where normalization + quantization interacts; quant kernels don't change tokenization but the combined pipeline does. Need mitigation on both sides.

maria: short-term: recommend we normalize inputs to NFC before tokenization in the eval harness and add a test set with emoji+ZWJ combos. That should reduce noisy eval churn.

hiro: longer term: revert the NFKC change in q8 runner and add explicit test coverage for grapheme cluster boundaries (emoji ZWJ, ZWNJ, Hangul jamo joiners).

alice: created a minimal patch: `tokenizer.pre_norm = 'NFC'` on staging -> rerunning small eval now.

devops-bot: canary-deploy: q8-staging 2026-03-18T09:22Z -> success (instances: 4/4)

eval-bot: rerun (small subset) after pre-norm: ja->zh BLEU -0.05, chrF -0.2, failing samples 3/50. looks much better.

cheng: thanks. can we add regression test to the eval suite that includes mixed Han+Kana+emoji ZWJ combos (10k synthetic variations)? put it behind fast checks so CI runs it.

maria: adding test ticket to backlog and marking as P0 for q8 rollouts: TICKET-8345.

hiro: pinging @platform infra — if we revert the normalization change we should coordinate with Dedicated customers on config drift.

alice: noted. I’ll open PR to make pre_norm configurable per deployment mode (default NFC). Also adding a small note in the bring-up checklist.

cheng: final ask — ML folks, please run the eval-harness with the full emoji-zwj subset before we flip q8 to prod. I’ll loop in SEs to watch any customer reports.

alice: will do one full run overnight and post results tomorrow AM. :coffee:
